resume: Flyfish plays a single piece: Chopin's Étude in C major, Op. 10 No. 1, on a sampled Steinway D. It can be played, shaped (rubato, touch, accents), practised (speed, loop, hand to play yourself) and transposed.

commandes.role: Piano page: STYLE, LEGATO, SOFT, TUNING.
Sound page: SOUND, BRIGHT, DECAY, WIDTH.
Mix page: RIGHT, LEFT, REVERB, SPACE.
RUBATO, TOUCH, ACCENT, PEDAL and the cascade (or the score). Held: MENU (COLOR, LOOK, VIEW, PITCH).
Variations: KEY, MODE, BASS, ROUNDS (how many rounds, INF by default).
Practice page: SPEED, FROM, TO, YOU; again: MODE, RAMP, CLICK, COUNT; again: RHYTHM, CHORDS, SHOW, ERASE.
Turns the loop between bars FROM and TO on or off.
Changes the sound, on all pages.
Chooses the bar to jump to (during play, at the next bar line).
To play along with the music, tap the notes or find the note; they play nothing but the piece.

a_savoir: The piece is unique: the firmware is not a free synth.
